blocks.text: Pani ki density (ghanapan) 4 °C par sab se zyada hoti hai. Is se neeche temperature girne par us ki density kam hone lagti hai, kyun ke hydrogen bonds pani ke molecules ko kuch door door rakhte hain. 0 °C par pani jam jata hai, magar banne wali barf (ice) liquid pani se kam dense hoti hai, kyun ke is temperature par hydrogen bonding molecules ko liquid pani se bhi zyada door rakhti hai.

Darya, nadiyon aur jheelon mein temperature girne par barf upar satah par banti hai. Barf pani se kam dense hai is liye satah par tairti hai. Yeh insulator (garmi ko guzarne na dene wali teh) ka kaam karti hai aur neeche ke pani ki garmi bahar nahin nikalne deti. Is tarah aquatic (pani mein rehne wale) jandar mehfooz rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Sardiyon mein ek talaab upar se jam jata hai. Pani ki do properties se samjhayein ke neeche machhliyan kyun zinda rehti hain.
blocks.explanation: Barf liquid pani se kam dense hai, kyun ke 0 °C par hydrogen bonds molecules ko zyada door rakhte hain; is liye barf upar tairti hai aur neeche ke pani ko insulate karti hai. Pani ki specific heat zyada hai, is liye neeche ka pani bohat aahista thanda hota hai aur machhliyon ke liye liquid aur kam-o-besh ek jaise temperature par rehta hai.

items: Pani jandaron ka 65 se 89 percent hai aur “medium of life” hai. Is ka molecule polar hai aur hydrogen bonds ka jaal banata hai.

Solvent: polar aur charge wali cheezein (salts, sugars, amino acids) hydrophilic hain aur hal hoti hain; non-polar lipids hydrophobic hain aur bahar dhakele jate hain, jis se membranes qaim rehti hain.

Zyada specific heat (4.184 J) temperature stable rakhti hai; zyada heat of vaporization (574 Kcal/kg) bhaap ke zariye thandak deti hai aur zameen ko motadil rakhti hai; cohesion pani ko xylem mein upar le jati hai aur surface tension deti hai.

Ionization se H⁺ aur OH⁻ bante hain (har ek 10⁻⁷ moles/litre); yeh pH tay karte hain aur enzymes ko khaas pH chahiye. 4 °C par sab se zyada density ki wajah se barf tairti hai aur aquatic zindagi bachati hai.
